# Annetta Bell

## Overview

- **Origin:** Newbridge school district  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Annetta Bell is a pale child with fine, silky, fawn-colored hair. Her smooth hair falls in ripples that flow over her shoulders.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## History

Annetta Bell moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after her parents relocated their house fifty yards north from the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) school district. As a student in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), she wrote a student letter as part of her classroom work.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), +3 more_
